verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party feature for bulk-exporting all account data in open formats. What it does show are read APIs (Transactions, Expenses, Accounting) that a developer could use to build an export, and a Zapier recipe that pushes card transactions to CSV in Google Drive. Both are developer building blocks or third-party workarounds, not a documented complete-data export from the product itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
